_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
O wena Mmadikgetho {player_id} mo Dikgetho Tse Tharo Tsa Tic Tac Toe.
Senthimithara sa gago ke '{symbol}'.
O tshwanelwa ke go dira senthimithara sa gago mo pampiring ya 5x5 go bopa mstari wa dinne.
Mistari e ka nna ya kwa godimo, ya kwa tlase, kgotsa ya tlhophagare.
Romelwa tsela ya gago ka tsela ya '[4]' go kaya selo 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopego sa go sutisa se se seng molaong. Dirisa "[cell]" fa sele e le 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nomoro ya selo e sa tsamma: {cell}. E tlile go tsama go na 0 le {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Motshameki {player_id} o dirile motsamao o sa siamang.

game_action.placed: Mmoki {player_id} o tlontsha seemo sa gagwe ({symbol}) mo karong ({row}, {col}).
